name: Hardware-Accelerated Non-Photorealistic Volume Rendering
aliases: Hardware Texture Volume Rendering with NPR Enhancements
definition: A volume rendering technique using two rendering passes per view-aligned polygon to apply tone shading, silhouettes, specular lighting, and depth-based color/opacity modulation using paletted textures and hardware interpolation.
summary: Hardware-Accelerated Non-Photorealistic Volume Rendering is a parallel technique for interactive scalar volume visualization that uses paletted textures and two rendering passes to decouple lighting and silhouette calculations from base opacity.
